about: QA (no2k15, 2026-11-23): a select_pages.json that still names the two WWE 2K15 test slots, taken out of the game -- by string ID, number, both, and name. Each is left out of his page, as anyone off the roster: no blank box, his neighbours close up (a page of 5: THE ROCK, STEVE AUSTIN, KANE, MANKIND, UNDERTAKER). The rest as the game's pages (append).
